profile.headline: Software Engineer with 13+ years shipping backend services for fintech, healthcare, and retail platforms
profile.summary: Passionate problem solver that simply loves to build. Grounded in pragmatism to deliver real business impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Back-end engineer on a global remittance platform responsible for last-mile fund delivery through a complex ecosystem of third-party payment integrations.

Led integration reliability and routing on a platform where partner outages frequently caused stuck payouts and customer cancellations.

Owned integration testing strategy and led critical cross-service fixes in a high-risk environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon SQS · Java · PostgreSQL · Spring Framework · Circuit Breakers · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) · Spring Boot · gRPC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack engineer on TD Ameritrade's Robo Advisor platform, delivering customer-facing portfolio features and supporting high-value client workflows in a highly iterative XP environment.
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · Spring Framework · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Apache Kafka · Microservices · PHP · Spring Boot · Kotlin · Amazon Dynamodb · REST APIs · Kubernetes

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
Back-end engineer on eCommerce platform services, building high-scale services for online ordering, pricing, and store operations.

Led dynamic delivery fee integration and legacy pricing engine migration on high-traffic services with strict latency requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · PostgreSQL · Spring Framework · Circuit Breakers · Microservices · RxJava · Spring Boot · ActiveMQ · REST APIs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description: Senior engineer leading on consulting engagements across large hospitality clients. Took on hands-on back-end and platform work while supporting engineers early in their careers.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · Agile Methodologies · Microservices · Spring Boot · docker · REST APIs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Contract at General Electric
positions.description: Built Java/Spring Boot services and Mustache-based report generation for business-facing research outputs ('ThinkSheets'). Acted as de facto back-end lead, enforcing higher review standards and aligning internal models and naming with business language to improve maintainability and shared understanding.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · MySQL · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Full-stack engineer contributing to customer-facing investment products (e.g. robo-advisor) and supporting back-end services.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · JavaScript · Microservices · AngularJS · Spring Boot · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer on Cerner's flagship EMR, working on foundational C++ APIs and middleware supporting clinical workflows in production healthcare environments.

Built and validated features with thorough service-level Java testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Python · Oracle Database · C++
